title: Coexistence Without Captivity: Protection Continuity and the Resource Cost of Autonomous Exit in Self-Modifying Multi-Agent Systems
author: Hongju Liu

claims.statement: A mutable displayed registry can make current checking vacuous while unreleased historical obligations fail
Outstanding protections survive transformations unless eligible release or justified target correspondence applies
A finite indispensable provider set without replacement cannot all permanently withdraw while its protected demand continues
Maximal retention until deadlines dominates early withdrawal under explicit exogeneity and monotonicity
Exact universal reserve is the maximum positive deadline-envelope Hall deficit across time, declared scenarios and demand subsets
Fixed allocations within observation cells have an exact common-edge/minimum-capacity Hall-deficit reserve; truthful refinement weakly reduces it
For every n>=2 a cyclic resource instance requires reserve1 with full information but reserve n with blind fixed allocation
Finite capacity cannot guarantee unlimited positive nonoverlapping additional demands
Finite history-lifted belief safety kernel characterizes sure-winning protection continuity and bounded withdrawal
8192 deadline-resource checks; 2048 evidence-resource checks; 33 local protocol configurations with seven accepted and four infeasible enhanced contracts
